parsed.change_summary: Added a check to prevent potential overflow before allocating memory for the buffer.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because a check has been added to ensure that the value of cnt does not exceed the maximum size that can be safely allocated. If cnt is very large and would cause an overflow, the code now handles this condition by logging an error and breaking out of the loop, thus preventing the buffer overflow.
